subject: EchoWorks: request to add three new apps + rate plan amendment
messages:
From: Simon Chen <simon.chen@echoworks.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@echoworks.io>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — three additional apps + uplift

Marcus —

Quick note from our side: the product org at EchoWorks wants to onboard three additional consumer-facing apps onto our current Redwood plan (SearchAssist, InboxGen, and ChatComposer). These will be new projects that need isolated API keys and basic role scoping; usage is expected to be bursty during business hours with peak QPS ~420 across all apps (current commit is 150 QPS).

Questions we need answered to plan next sprint:
- Can you provide a path to provision 3 new project keys scoped to the same account?
- What does a short-term throughput uplift look like (30 days) vs a sustained commit change?
- Any delta to unit pricing or minimums if we add the extra capacity this quarter?
- How quickly can we get staging keys to run smoke tests?

Looping in procurement for PO routing. We may need a one-month uplift to handle expected peaks while we evaluate commit adjustments. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Simon Chen
Head of Product — EchoWorks
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Chen <simon.chen@echoworks.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — three additional apps + uplift

Simon — great to hear EchoWorks is expanding usage. High level replies below and next steps in the mutual action plan (MAP) at the end.

Provisioning keys and scoping
- Yes — we can provision three dedicated project-scoped API keys under your tenant. Keys will be scoped to project-level RBAC (team owners + read-only monitors).
- Staging keys: we can issue temporary staging keys within 24 business hours after we receive the signed amendment.

Throughput uplift options
- Short-term surge (30 days): we can enable burst capacity via our Dedicated surge pool. Suggested charge: a one-time surge fee equivalent to 30% of estimated monthly usage, plus per-token usage at standard overage rates. This avoids immediate commit changes.
- Sustained commit increase: suggested new commit profile would be 500 QPS for a 12-month amendment, which lowers effective per-token price vs overages. I attached a quick pricing sketch (MAAP-pricing-proposal.xlsx).

SLA and capacity
- To support 420 QPS reliably we recommend default auto-scaling + a reserved burst window. We can add an SLA exception for peak latency targets if you need stricter guarantees; that requires a short intake and approval.

Next steps (mutual action plan)
1) EchoWorks: decision whether this is a 30-day surge or new commit (Simon / Procurement) — target: 2027-05-28
2) Redwood: prepare amendment with pricing and DocuSign — owner: Marcus — target: 2027-05-28 EOD
3) EchoWorks: sign amendment + submit PO — owner: Procurement — target: 2027-05-31
4) Redwood: provision staging keys once signed + run smoke tests — owner: Monica — target: 24 business hours after signature

I'll draft the amendment and share the DocuSign link this afternoon. Monica — can you prepare the staging key flow and check auto-scaling parameters for 420 QPS? Naomi — I'll need a quick SLA exception writeup in case they request lower tail latency.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: Asha Rao <asha@echoworks.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Chen <simon.chen@echoworks.io>, EchoWorks Procurement <procurement@echoworks.io>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — three additional apps + uplift

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clarity. Procurement prefers DocuSign + a line-item PO. For our timeline we need staging keys ASAP to validate integrations; if you can issue temporary staging keys under a Mutual NDA hold while the amendment is routing, that would speed things up.

On the surge vs commit decision: we want to run the apps for 30 days to collect production telemetry and then commit if metrics look good. So plan is: short-term surge for June, evaluate, then move to commit in July. Please include the 30-day surge option in the amendment.

Best,
Asha
Product Operations — EchoWorks
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: EchoWorks Procurement <procurement@echoworks.io>, Simon Chen <simon.chen@echoworks.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — three additional apps + uplift

Understood. I've prepared the amendment with both paths (30-day surge and 12-month commit to 500 QPS). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/MTX-9412-EW-amend (see related links).

Highlights in the amendment:
- Temporary surge clause: one-month burst at defined cap (up to 600 QPS) with clear cap protection and overage rates.
- Commit option: 12-month commit at 500 QPS with a 14% discount vs current list.
- Provisioning: three project-scoped API keys; staging keys available as temporary tokens valid for 10 days post-signature or pre-signature under an NDA.
- SLA: included an optional addendum for tighter p95 latency during peak windows — Naomi has a one-pager attached.

Attachments: MAAP-pricing-proposal.xlsx; EchoWorks_Throughput_SLA_Request.pdf (Naomi's writeup).

Monica will provision staging tokens once procurement confirms NDA or the signed amendment is in place. Monica — please coordinate with EchoWorks for test endpoint whitelisting.

I'll route the DocuSign now; let me know if procurement needs any line-item changes for invoicing.

—Marcus
From: EchoWorks Procurement <procurement@echoworks.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@echoworks.io>, Simon Chen <simon.chen@echoworks.io>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EchoWorks expansion — PO and NDA confirmation

Marcus — attaching the PO (EchoWorks_PO_20270528.pdf). We confirmed the short-term surge route and signed the DocuSign amendment earlier today. Per our compliance team, we can accept temporary staging keys under the NDA for the 10-day window you mentioned.

Requested notes for invoice: please show the one-time surge fee as a separate line item and include our billing address (on the PO). We also attached a brief SLA request doc for the latency addendum.

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Looking forward to staging keys so our infra team can run smoke tests Monday morning.

Regards,
EchoWorks Procurement
[attachment: EchoWorks_PO_20270528.pdf]
